desc: ONE lovable theatrical gray WOLF: chunky charcoal back, cream face cheeks and broad muzzle, TWO POINTED upright ears, TWO bushy dark eyebrows, huge gray brush tail with creamy tip, FOUR strong cream sock paws. Cute mischievous narrow amber eyes with tiny shine; round soft shapes, not realistic or scary. Recognizable wolf silhouette with long canine muzzle, stronger and larger than a puppy.
gait: FOUR-legged balanced canine walk: FOUR distinguishable articulated paws, each pair alternates evenly; stable head and torso, natural knee/hock flexion and tail follow-through. Eight sequential walk phases, opposite support at frame 5, planted feet move backward and lifted feet swing forward. No limping, no phantom extra leg.
prompt:
Production SPRITE ATLAS for an original cute farm pixel-art game. The attached atlas is a STYLE reference only: use its warm colors, crisp dark pixel outlines, chunky readable pixel clusters, simple friendly small eyes and rounded appealing proportions. Do NOT copy the dog anatomy. Subject: ONE lovable theatrical gray WOLF: chunky charcoal back, cream face cheeks and broad muzzle, TWO POINTED upright ears, TWO bushy dark eyebrows, huge gray brush tail with creamy tip, FOUR strong cream sock paws. Cute mischievous narrow amber eyes with tiny shine; round soft shapes, not realistic or scary. Recognizable wolf silhouette with long canine muzzle, stronger and larger than a puppy.
EXACTLY 8 ROWS x 8 COLUMNS = 64 separate whole characters on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Equal cells. Each animal must fit within the middle 60% of its cell with broad transparent gutters on ALL sides. No clipping, shadows, floor, labels or grid lines. Whole tail, ears, feet and wings remain inside each cell.
One genuine direction per row in this EXACT order: 1 SOUTH/front; 2 SOUTHWEST/front-left 45 degrees; 3 WEST/left PROFILE; 4 NORTHWEST/back-left 45 degrees; 5 NORTH/back; 6 NORTHEAST/back-right 45 degrees; 7 EAST/right PROFILE; 8 SOUTHEAST/front-right 45 degrees. Front and rear diagonals must visibly differ from straight front, rear and side views. Fixed 20-degree elevated orthographic camera, same physical anatomy, scale, colors and proportions for all 64 poses.
Animation across EACH row: FOUR-legged balanced canine walk: FOUR distinguishable articulated paws, each pair alternates evenly; stable head and torso, natural knee/hock flexion and tail follow-through. Eight sequential walk phases, opposite support at frame 5, planted feet move backward and lifted feet swing forward. No limping, no phantom extra leg. A complete seamless eight-frame cycle with no repeated endpoint. Keep body center and grounded foot plane stable. Every body part is present throughout the cycle. Deliberate clean PIXEL ART, approximately 64 pixels of detail per animal, no smooth vector style, no gradients, no glossy enormous eyes. Consistent individual face and identity.
